terminal_install_prompt_body:
{isem_n_terminal} ad yeldi tura axeddim {tarrayt}.

• Ma yella ur ixeddem ara yakan, sfeḍ {aselkim}-ik.
• Ma yella yeqqen ɣer USB, sfeḍ-it uqbel.
{asmekti}
• Qqen aselkim-ik s aselkim-ik mi ara yeldi usmel {terminal_name}.

Kned ɣef OK akken ad t-tessufɣeḍ yerna ad teffɣeḍ seg Updater CE.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Tiswiɛt: Ma yella ur yettwaqqen ara usmel s wudem awurman, s tɣawla tḍeggreḍ aqerruy n usnefli yellan deg tɣerɣert n tmeẓẓuɣt s tmeẓẓuɣt n lkaɣeḍ deg wakud aydeg ara tcuddeḍ aẓeḍḍa n USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Tiswiɛt: Ssers aselkim-ik deg tegnit n usnulfu n usmel (yemgarad s lemtel: amedya, kkset aṭaṭar u ḥrez-it s lxiḍ USB icudden, neɣ sfeḍ s tbatrit deg-s, neɣ ḥebbes Volume Down/Up mi ara tcuddeḍ USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Sbedd s GUI n wallal n SP Flash
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI ad yeldi tura s usmel-ik n tmeẓdit yettwasbedden uqbel.

• Deg SP Flash Tool, fren "Asnulfu n wakk + Asenqed" seg tfelwit n tfelwit.
• Klik ɣef tfelwit "Asmel".
• Ḥezzeb belli {aselkim-ik} yettwaxdem yerna yettwaqleɛ.
{asmekti}
• Qqen aselkim USB ɣer uselkim-ik deffir ma tḍeggreḍ Download.

Kned ɣef OK akken ad tesbeddeḍ Allal n SP Flash yerna ad teffɣeḍ seg Useɣzef CE.

sp_gui_launch_intro:
GUI n wallal n SP Flash ad d-yeffeɣ tura.

• Ma yella ur ixeddem ara yakan, sfeḍ aselkim-ik.
• Ma yella yeqqen ɣer USB, sfeḍ-it uqbel.
• Deg SP Flash Tool, efk-d Asenqed (neɣ Asenqed akk + Asenqed akken ilaq).

Syin qqen lxiḍ USB akken ad tebduḍ ad t-tefkeḍ.

donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Nesbedd {aselkim} ɣef {amudel}-inek.

Azul! Nekk d Ryan, d amsnulfu deffir n Usebded n MediaTek. Nekk ttḍeggiɛeɣ idrimen n usmel d uḥezzeb seg lǧib akken ad yeqqim usebter-agi d ilelli yerna yeldi. Ma yella teɛna-k, ttxil-k xemmem ad tefkeḍ — tettaǧǧa asenfar ad yidir i yal yiwen.
donate_intro_general_mediatek: Iy! Nekk d Ryan, d amsnulfu deffir n Usebded n MediaTek. Nekk ttxelliseɣ asenqed, allalen d uḥezzeb seg tkebbanit-iw akken ad qqimeɣ d ilelli n usebter-agi. Aḥareb n yal agur yettaweḍ ɣer wazal n 200 n yidulaṛen — yal aɛiwen ara d-tefkeḍ yettɛawan ad yeqqim yedder i useqdac i d-iteddun.
donate_intro_success:
Nesbedd {aselkim} ɣef {amudel}-inek.

Azul! Nekk d Ryan, d amsnulfu deffir Updater CE, Taɣult n Uselkim Ameẓyan n Temnaḍt, d Tgemmi n Yisental. Nekk ttḍeggiɛeɣ ~200 n yidulaṛen n yal agur n uqeddac-nneɣ d tɣawsiwin n uḥezzeb seg lǧib akken ad yeqqim kullec d ilelli yerna yeldi. Ma yella allal-agi yeɛna-k, ttxil-k xemmem ad t-tefkeḍ — yettḥadar iɣbula-agi i yal yiwen.
donate_intro_general: Iy! Nekk d Ryan, d amsnulfu deffir Updater CE, Taɣult n Uselkim Ameẓyan n Temnaḍt, d Tgemmi n Yisental. Nekk ttxelliseɣ asenqed n uqeddac, aḥezzeb n tfelwit n usmel, d usnefli n yiḥricen seg tkebbanit-iw akken ad yeqqim kullec d ilelli. Aḥareb n yal agur yettaweḍ ɣer wazal n 200 n yidulaṛen — yal aɛiwen ara d-tefkeḍ yettɛawan ad qqimen wallalen-a ddren i bab-nsen ay d-iteddun.

reminder_dont_remind_device: Ur iyi-d-smektay ara ɣef yisuḍaf imaynuten n wallal-a
reminder_prompt_install: Tebɣiḍ ad tebduḍ asras fell-as (s tarrayt-ik i d-tefrenḍ: {tarrayt})?
retry_guidance_intro: Acuddu USB s umyurar-ik yeḥbes tiririt. Amyurar-ik yeḥwaǧ asenqes s ufus uqbel ad yezmer ɛewwel nniḍen ad ixeddem.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Ḍefret aqerruy n usnefli yeffren s tmeẓẓuɣt, s tmeẓẓuɣt n lkaɣeḍ neɣ s tmeẓẓuɣt.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Ssekcem-d aẓeḍḍa USB-nni, syen ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
settings_reminders_tracked: Ad k-id-sfehmen mi ara d-yeffeɣ usmel amaynut i useɣzan ara tesbeddeḍ deg {iɣerruba}. Yettwaḍfer tura: {aselkim}
settings_method_desc: Amek yettwaru firmware i umyurar-ik. Aḍris XML n tmeẓdit n SP Flash Tool d abrid yettwassumren deg Windows d Linux; macOS iseqdac amsaɣ MTK.
flash_method_note_mtk_mac: Aḍris n macOS yettwasqedcen: yettḍeggiɛ asenqed n Mac deg tmacint-a — MTKClient d netta kan ay d aḍris n tmeẓdit yerna ttwaseknen-d yisuḍaf n macOS. I lmend n ujerred kan; app-nni yettkemmil yettkemmil akken ad yettwaxdem.
simulated_mac_title: Beddel ɣer tegnit n macOS yettwasqedcen
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient yettuɣal d tarrayt kan n usbedd yerna ttwaseknen-d yisuḍaf n macOS. Ilaq ad yerr MediaTek Installer akken ad yesseqdec aya.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient yettuɣal d tarrayt kan n usbedd yerna ttwaseknen-d yisuḍaf n macOS. Updater CE yessefk ad yerr ad yebdu akken ad yesseqdec aya.
sel_instructions_below: Ttxil ḍefreḍ iwellihen yellan ddaw-a iwakken ad tesbeddeḍ aseɣzan-a ɣef {lbl}-inek.
sel_install_tooltip: Sbedd neɣ rret aselkim n unagraw yettwafernen ɣer {lbl}-inek.
mtk_da_required: Fren Agent n Usekles uqbel ad tebduḍ asras.
sel_type_help_tooltip: Ɛreḍ Aselkim n Uselkim n Ṣṣenf A d amezwaru. Ma yella ur d-terri ara tkerrust-ik n usmel deffir n usbedd, sbedd yiwen seg yiferdisen n ṣṣenf B.
device_type_help_msg:
Ɛreḍ Aselkim n Uselkim n Ṣṣenf A d amezwaru.

Ma yella ur d-terri ara tkerrust-ik n usmel deffir n usbedd, sbedd yiwen seg yiferdisen n ṣṣenf B.
install_disconnect_guidance_fmt:
Send ad tkemleḍ, ɛafak:

1. Ma yella ur ixsi ara yakan, sfeḍ {label}-ik
   (Tzemreḍ ad tesqedceḍ aɛekkaz neɣ aɛekkaz n lkaɣeḍ akken ad tḍeggreḍ aqerruy n uɛiwed ma yella ilaq)

2. Ma yella yeqqen, qqen aselkim USB seg {label}-ik.

Syin, efk-d OK yerna ḍeffer imeslayen yellan deg tfelwit.
sp_gui_prompt_steps_fmt:
• Ma yella ur yettwaxdem ara yakan, sfeḍ {label}-ik.
• Ma yella yeqqen ɣer USB, sfeḍ-it uqbel.
• Deg SP Flash Tool, efk-d Asenqed (neɣ Asenqed akk + Asenqed akken ilaq).

Syin qqen lxiḍ USB akken ad tebduḍ ad t-tefkeḍ.
sel_type_help_body:
Ɛreḍ Aselkim n Uselkim n Ṣṣenf A d amezwaru.

Ma yella ur d-terri ara tkerrust-ik n usmel deffir n usbedd, sbedd yiwen seg yiferdisen n ṣṣenf B.
sel_install_tooltip_generic: Sbedd neɣ aɛiwed n useɣzan n unagraw yettwafernen ɣer wallal-ik
dl_retry_fmt: Tuqqna tettwagdel. Aɛraḍ n tikkelt nniḍen ({aɛraḍ}/{aɛraḍ})...
linux_engine_staged_desc: Allal n Flash n MediaTek SP yettwasbedd s tmeẓla n libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Kned ɣef Uɛiwed n usefqed neɣ aɛiwed n usbedd akken ad tesniḍ aferdis.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: Ilugan n MediaTek ttwaxedmen (/atg/udev/ilugan.d/). Akeccum n uselkim yettwasbedd.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Efk-d izerfan yiwet n tikkelt akken ad yezmer uselkim ad yettmeslay d tmeẓdit-ik.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Izerfan n USB & ilugan n udev ttwasersen s rrbeḥ. Imeẓla ttwasemrasen.
donate_rely_on_you: Nettkel ɣef tikciwin-nwen akken ad nkemmel ad nexdem. Efk tura
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Ldi GUI n wallal n Flash n MediaTek SP
action_searching: Anadi ɣef wallal (qqim ur yettwaqqen ara)...
action_brom_detected: Allal yettwafser deg tegnit n BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash ikemmel! Qqes USB u rẓem-it.
action_recover_powercycle: Ssexdem tazmert n umyurar (ḥebbes tazmert ~10s), syen ɛiwed qqen-it - ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen...
action_wait_mtk: Raǧu ahil n MTK... Ssexsi ahil u qqen USB.
action_da_stall: Aselkim yeḥbes tiririt deg wakud n usebded n umeẓlu n usekles. Sfeḍ-it akk, ɛreḍ-it, ɛreḍ-it-id.
action_detected_brom: Aselkim yettwafser (aḥric n BROM) - asebded n umeggi n usekles...
action_detected_preloader: Yettwassen wallal (aḥric n usekles uqbel) - asebded n umasay n usekles...
action_da_wait_back: Amyurar yeḥbes tiririt deg wakud aydeg yebda agensas n usnulfu. Ttraǧuɣ ad d-tuɣal...
action_device_connected: Allal yeqqen - aheggi n yifuyla n tira...
action_formatting: Asemres n yisefka n useqdac d tmeẓdit...
action_restart_brom: Aɛiwed n umyurar deg tegnit n BROM...
log_install_writing: Sbedd deg Ukemmel - tira n tugniwin n useɣzan amecṭuḥ...
log_sparse_fmt: Tettwassen tugna n Android tameẓyant i {aḥric}, tettbeddil deg ukala...
err_code_connection_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yeqqen ɣer wallal
err_code_mtk_init_failed: Amsaɣ MTK ur yezmir ara ad yebdu
err_code_mtk_import_failed: MTKClient ur yezmir ara ad yettwacarreg
err_code_sp_not_found: Ur yettwaf ara wallal n SP Flash
err_code_no_scatter: Ulac afaylu n usferreq deg tferkit
err_code_missing_images: Tugniwin n useɣzan amecṭuḥ xuṣṣent deg tferkit
themepack_card_title: Sbedd Tagrumma n Usentel n Rockbox n 360p
themepack_card_desc: Yella deg-s isentalen n tmetti icebḥen, tifelwiyin n uswir n tfelwit, d tfelwiyin yettwaxedmen s umata i tfelwiyin n 360p.
themepack_dialog_title: Asebded n Tferkit n Usentel n Rockbox 360p
themepack_step1_title: Akaz 1: Acuddu deg tegnit n uḥezzeb USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Ssexdem amyurar-ik s tmeẓẓuɣt n Power.
2. Mi ara d-yeffeɣ Rockbox, sqedceḍ aẓeḍḍa n USB deg uselkim-ik.
3. Ma yella yettwasteqsa deg tfelwit n umyurar, sbedd aḍris n Uḥezzeb n USB akken ad d-yeffeɣ wallal-nni am tmeẓdit.
themepack_step2_title: Akaz wis 2: Fren yal Aḍris deg Umyurar
themepack_step2_desc: Imi inagrawen n uselkim (am macOS) ffren ifuyla n tfelwiyin (am .rockbox) s tɣawla, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ KRA n uḍris neɣ aẓar n tfelwit deg umyurar-ik. Ad ak-naf neɣ ad d-nesnulfu aḍris .rockbox s wudem awurman.
themepack_status_downloading: Asekcem n tferkit n usentel n 360p...
themepack_complete: Tagrumma n usentel tettwasbedd s rrbeḥ! Tzemreḍ tura ad tfeḍ amseḍru-inek s laman yerna ad tefrenḍ asentel deg Rockbox (Islugnan > Islugnan n usentel).
themepack_err_not_found: Ur yezmir ara ad yaf neɣ ad yebdu aḍris .rockbox deg uḍris yettwafernen. Ttxil ḍemneḍ belli tferneḍ aḍris deg umyurar-ik.
rockbox_wizard_title: Asebded n Isental d Tira n Rockbox 360p
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Kker ɣer tegnit n uḥezzeb USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Akaz 1: Ɛiwed aɛiwed n umyurar u ɛiwed tuqqna
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Ssexsi lxiḍ USB.
2. Ssexdem amyurar-nni s lǧehd yerna ǧǧ-it ad yebdu deg Rockbox.
3. Mi ara ixeddem Rockbox, ɛiwed qqen aẓeḍḍa n USB, syen tḍeggreḍ Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Tikkelt tis 2: Anadi ɣef umyurar ɣef ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App-a yettwali tuqqna n ADB (arma d 30 n tesdidin). Ma yella yettwaf yiwen n wallal, isentalen ttwaɛezlen yerna amyurar yettwaɛreḍ s wudem awurman. Ma ulac, sqedceḍ sdat n Udem n Uḥezzeb USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Raǧu allal n ADB... (ar 30 n tesdidin)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Ur yettwafhim ara usmel n ADB deg 30 n tesdidin; tkemmel s Udem n Uḥezzeb USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Ur yelli ara ADB binary i yellan deg tesgilt; tkemmel s Udem n Uḥezzeb USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Aḥettem n yisental d tfelwiyin ɣef ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Asiweḍ n ADB ur yezmir ara; Yeɣli-d ɣer tegnit n uḥezzeb USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Sbedd s Udem n Uḥezzeb USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Ssexdem USB Storage Mode deg umyurar akken ad d-yeffeɣ am tmeẓdit.
2. Fren KRA n uḍris yellan deg umyurar ddaw-a (.rockbox, Aẓawan, Isentaalen, neɣ aẓar n tmeẓdit — aḍris .rockbox yeffren yettwasbedd s wudem awurman).
3. App-a yesdukkel isentalen d tfelwiyin n 360p deg, yettaru-d ifuyla n yiwen n yisem.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Tzemreḍ tura ad tfeḍ amrar s laman yerna ad tferneḍ asentel deg Rockbox (Islugnan > Islugnan n usentel).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Lqem aqbur n Updater mazal-it deg uselkim-a yerna yettaṭṭaf amḍiq deg uḍris. Tukksa-ines tessufuɣ-d amkan-nni.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Yettnadi azal n {tajumma} n umḍiq deg uḍris
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Kkes asenfar aqbur n Innioasis Updater d yifuyla n tallelt
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Ḥrez allalen n tmeẓdit n Android (ADB / Fastboot) ttwasersen
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Ma yella ur tesqedceḍ ara ADB neɣ Fastboot berra n Updater CE, sfeḍ asekkil akken ad tesfeḍ yerna ad d-terreḍ aḥezzeb n usnerni.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Ssizdeg s rrbeḥ asersi aqbur d usnerni n umḍiq n uḍris.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Lqem aqbur n Updater mazal-it deg uselkim-a. Tukksa-ines tessufuɣ-d amḍiq deg uḍris.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Aya yekkes-d ahil aqbur d yifuyla-ines n tallelt. Aselkim ameẓyan yettwaḍeggren yettwaḥrez.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kkes-d Allalen n Tmeẓdit n Android (ADB / Fastboot) daɣen? Fren Keep ma yella tesqedceḍ ADB.
